sermon.title: Do Intolerant Bible Haters and Bashers Really Understand The Bible?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this session of “Clarity on Crucial Choices,” Pastor David G. Kincer asks whether those who hate and bash the Bible really understand it. He describes the faiths he says oppose the Bible, answers claims that it was written by ignorant men, contradicts science or approves of slavery, and says the Bible was written to reveal eternal life through Jesus Christ and to teach people how to treat one another right.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: This is a radio-style session titled “Clarity on Crucial Choices.” Some references are spoken as run-together numbers in the captions and were written out: “Psalms 336 and verse 9” as Psalm 33:6 and 9, “Job 267” as Job 26:7, “Exodus 2116” as Exodus 21:16, “Luke 234” as Luke 23:4 (Pilate finding no fault in Jesus). Some passages are quoted without naming the reference (e.g. Leviticus 17:11, Revelation 22:18-19, Matthew 24:6-7); the linked references are the passages he is quoting. Statistics and historical claims are given as spoken and have not been checked.

chunks.section_question: Do people who hate and bash the Bible really understand it?
chunks.short_answer: He asks whether those who hate and bash the Bible and Jesus, and are intolerant of people who follow Jesus, really understand the Bible. He says the world’s many faiths insist on acceptance and respect, and from First Corinthians 14:9 he says we need clarity, because none of these faiths is without significance in its requirements, its purpose and its consequences.

faqs.question: Which “faiths” does he say the world insists on?
faqs.answer: He names humanists (including free thinkers, atheists, agnostics and communists), the evolutionist faith, the same-sex faith, the sexually permissive faith, liberals and progressives, and religionists, including other religions and offshoots of Christianity.

faqs.question: Did creation take millions of years?
faqs.answer: He says when God spoke the heavens were made, the plants came forth and mankind came about, “not 1 million years not 4 billion years.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth. He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap; He lays up the deep in storehouses. Let all the earth fear the LORD; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him. For He spoke, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.

faqs.question: What three attacks do critics make on the Bible?
faqs.answer: He says critics claim the Bible was written by ignorant men, is full of contradictions and approves of slavery, and is a book of myths, allegories and hate, not science.

faqs.question: What scientific facts does he say the Bible contained early?
faqs.answer: He says the writers knew the earth hangs on nothing, understood the water cycle and ocean currents, and knew life was in the blood while scientists were still bleeding men to cure disease.

scriptures.text_nkjv: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth on nothing.

faqs.question: What did he ask opponents of the Bible about slavery?
faqs.answer: He says he wrote to them asking how they can say the Bible approves slavery when it disapproves of kidnapping, and none of them answered.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “He who kidnaps a man and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, shall surely be put to death.

faqs.question: Is believing in eternal life unscientific?
faqs.answer: He says it is not unscientific, because it deals with supernatural things and science deals with physical things, and the knowledge of eternal life hurts no one.

faqs.question: Is the Old Testament about Jesus?
faqs.answer: From Luke 24:44, where Jesus says all things written in the law of Moses, the prophets and the Psalms concerning him must be fulfilled, he says the whole Old Testament is about Jesus.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then He said to them, “These are the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms concerning Me.”

faqs.question: Should we be patient with ourselves and others?
faqs.answer: He says we have to be patient with ourselves and with others, but we cannot give up; we need to add moral excellence.

faqs.question: What if someone rejects Jesus?
faqs.answer: He says if you want to reject Jesus, “that’s your choice,” but we cannot allow the hurting of innocent people because of our faith.

faqs.question: Are sin and crime the same thing?
faqs.answer: He says the word sin and the word crime are synonymous terms for violating the moral laws.
